verdict.rationale: Plugging in MCP servers is something an AI agent or assistant host does. The Ohio Secretary of State is a government business-filing and records service (Gateway portal, OHID sign-in, Business Central), not an agent that consumes external tools, so this axis is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the product embeds an AI assistant that could act as an MCP client, so the exception that would make the axis apply is not triggered.
